representation_fit.evidence: Brief asks understand × temporal-sequence over change_set with readable causality; implementation is a time-scaled SVG chronology of change-set nodes with cause→effect edges, phase bands, and a state slice computed as fold(changes ≤ t) (source/app.js:88-111, source/app.js:218-233, source/data.js:5-7 domain model). Both screenshots show the timeline as the dominant surface with the causal chain of the preselected incident drawn left→right in orange (screenshots/1280x860.png, screenshots/1440x900.png).

primary_task_salience.evidence: Timeline card is the first and largest section (source/index.html:20, '主区（dominant）'); app boots with c16 — the P0 incident — preselected, its cause chain highlighted and the detail panel opened on 诱因/操作/引发的变更 (source/app.js:156; screenshots/1280x860.png right panel 'P0：预售开场支付大面积超时'). Header subtitle states the job: '状态演化 × 因果追溯' (source/index.html:13).

time_to_understand.evidence: Fast orientation aids are present: encoding hint '连线方向 = 时间方向：诱因永远在左，后果永远在右' (source/index.html:23), typed legend with counts, footer integrity line '因果方向与时间顺序一致 ✓' (both screenshots), and a prepopulated worked example. Held at 4 because first-parse density is high (5 type lanes, 5 phase bands, 8 component lanes, 24 labeled nodes) and node/lane labels are authored at 10-10.5px in a 1180-wide viewBox (source/styles.css:111-114), matching the type.min_projected_size fail in measurement-summary.json — labels are noticeably smaller at 1280x860 than 1440x900.

navigation_cost.evidence: Any change_set is reachable in one action from the initial screen: click a node/edge/lane tick (source/app.js:264, 232, 328), ←/→ sequential stepping, C jump-to-cause / E jump-to-effect / Esc clear (source/app.js:500-508, echoed in footer kbd hints in both screenshots), plus ?sel=/&cursor= deep links (source/app.js:552-565). No modes, no page transitions.

context_loss.evidence: Single-screen workspace: select/cursor/filter update detail and snapshot panels in place (source/app.js:440-446 updateAll; source/styles.css:47-53 grid), position is preserved ('第 16 / 24 项' source/app.js:345; visible in both screenshots), and jumps from cause/effect rows re-render in place (source/app.js:395-397). No navigation away from the primary object exists.

ui_surface_complexity.evidence: Six permanent surfaces (header+legend, filter toolbar, timeline, detail, snapshot, footer) and modest controls: 9 filter chips + play button (source/index.html:25-31, source/app.js:519-529), draggable cursor, 4 key bindings. Each maps to a brief facet (chips→many entities, cursor+snapshot→evolving state, detail→change semantics), but the aggregate control surface is dense relative to the single-screen scale; the toolbar already wraps at 1280x860.

accessibility.evidence: All three a11y receipt checks fail: a11y.contrast=fail, a11y.focus_order=fail, a11y.target_size=fail (measurement-summary.json checks). Source shows intent — nodes carry tabindex=0/role=button (source/app.js:241), :focus ring (source/styles.css:120), aria-labels (source/index.html:20,33) — but visible text is 10-11.5px in light grays (#8a93a3/#8a93a3-family fills, source/styles.css:106-114, source/styles.css:209) and chips are ~2px vertical padding (source/styles.css:78-87), consistent with the contrast and target-size failures.

frontend_rework.evidence: Two of four layout/text checks fail: layout.responsive_collision=fail and type.min_projected_size=fail (measurement-summary.json), while layout.overflow=pass and text.truncation=pass. Visible correlates: at 1280x860 the toolbar wraps, pushing '切片时刻 05-31 20:05' and ▶播放 onto a second row (screenshots/1280x860.png vs one-row layout at screenshots/1440x900.png), and SVG labels shrink below comfortable size at 1280. No broken overlap or clipped text is visible, so defects are real but localized — moderate rework, not structural.

acceptance_seed_coverage.evidence: Seed '时间结构与变更语义一致' is enforced and surfaced: data-layer integrity check rejects cause links not strictly forward in time and unknown fields (source/app.js:52-64), footer renders '完整性校验：因果方向与时间顺序一致 ✓' (visible in both screenshots, source/app.js:536); snapshot and detail before/after derive from one fold function (mc2, source/app.js:88-122); near-simultaneous c16→c17 edge is drawn as a loop preserving left→right semantics (source/app.js:222-224); ?selftest=1 asserts state semantics at key times (source/app.js:576-589).

defects_observed: a11y.contrast, a11y.focus_order, and a11y.target_size all fail (measurement-summary.json checks) despite source-level a11y intent (source/app.js:241, source/styles.css:120)

scores.overall_note: This is a strong fit for the brief's understand × temporal-sequence cell: the initial screen is dominated by a time-scaled change-set chronology whose causal edges are structurally guaranteed to run forward in time (source/app.js:52-64, footer integrity line visible in both screenshots), and the state slice is computed as the same fold that supplies before/after values in the detail panel (source/app.js:88-122), directly addressing the acceptance seed. Navigation to the primary object is one click or one keypress with no context loss, and a preselected incident with its highlighted cause chain gives an immediate worked example. The weaknesses are measurable rather than structural: three a11y checks fail (contrast, focus order, target size) consistent with 10-11.5px light-gray labeling and minimal chip padding, and two layout checks fail with visible symptoms at 1280x860 (toolbar wrap, sub-minimum projected type). Completion time, retrieval accuracy, and human preference cannot be judged from this package, and model judgment of comprehensibility here is a proxy, not a human preference measurement.
